Name: Content Patcher - Marshmallows in Stardew
Author: callysquared
Description:
This is a back-to-basics port of my original Marshmallows in Stardew mod, now using Content Patcher instead of JSON Assets.
It does not currently include the extra Chocolatiering content, though maybe in time I'll add that too.

The mod includes:
1 new Crop - Marsh Mallow, which can be grown in Spring and Summer, with a Giant variation. This is a Paddy crop, like Rice, and so grows quicker near water.
3 new purchasable Cooking Recipes - Marshmallow, Blue Marshmallow and Rainbow Marshmallow, which can be purchased from Gus, Sandy and Krobus respectively. These have helpful, but maybe OP buffs.
2 new craftable Weapons, Marshmallow Skewer and it's crispy counter part, Charred Marshmallow Skewer
2 new marshmallow themed edibles - Chocolate Fish and Rocky Road which can be purchased from Willy and the Dwarf respectively (once at Level 3 Fishing/Mining)

Acquiring recipes:
[spoiler]
The base marshmallow recipe has no purchase requirements, but the Blue Marshmallow and Rainbow Marshmallow recipes will only show up once 10k and 100k have been earned, respectively.
The Marshmallow Skewer recipe is available from Krobus once all 3 Marshmallow recipes have been purchased, and the Charred Marshmallow Skewer can be purchase from the Volcano shop once you have the original Marshmallow Skewer recipe.[/spoiler]

I haven't tested, but I would not recommend mixing it with my original mod, although the original mod can be found here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5157]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5157[/url]
I have brought over the Chocolate Fish and Rocky Road from it, but as standalone items rather than recipes for now.

I don't think there should be any incompatibilities, as it's a very simple mod, but I will add them if I come across any.
